description: Longueurs départementales annuelle des canalisations du réseau de transport de gaz français is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente, par département, les longueurs cumulées de canalisations de transport de gaz en service et leur diamètre nominal maximal (DN max), déclinées selon la nature du réseau ( principal ou régional ) et son opérateur (Terega ou NaTran). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Infrastructures. Its keywords are Tableau de Bord Régional, SIG. The portal shows 2019-10-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
